description: This file declares the PidFd class which provides an interface for managing process file descriptors, including launching subprocesses, retrieving process information, copying file descriptors, and halting process hierarchies within the process sandboxer component of the Cuttlefish project.
external_methods: absl::StatusOr<PidFd> PidFd::LaunchSubprocess(absl::Span<const std::string>, std::vector<std::pair<sapi::file_util::fileops::FDCloser, int>>, absl::Span<const std::string>)

classes.name: PidFd
classes.description: A class that manages process file descriptors, allowing process control such as launching subprocesses, retrieving process info, copying file descriptors, and halting process hierarchies.

methods.name: FromRunningProcess
methods.description: Returns a managed pidfd tracking a previously started process with the specified pid.

methods.name: LaunchSubprocess
methods.description: Launches a subprocess and returns a pidfd tracking the newly launched process.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Returns the file descriptor associated with the process.

methods.name: AllFds
methods.description: Copies file descriptors from the target process, mapping them into the current process.

methods.name: Argv
methods.description: Retrieves the argument vector of the process.

methods.name: Env
methods.description: Retrieves the environment variables of the process.

methods.name: HaltHierarchy
methods.description: Halts the process and all its descendants.

methods.name: HaltChildHierarchy
methods.description: Halts all descendants of the process.

methods.name: SendSignal
methods.description: Sends a signal to the process.
